title: Bear Snores On
author: Karma Wilson

hero.name: Bear (Bear Snores On)
hero.description: Large brown bear sleeping in a cave, the central character of the book — generic enough that a good Boardmaker brown bear icon may suffice, but the sleeping pose is distinctive
hero.source_note: Generic sleeping bear — use Boardmaker 'bear' or 'bear sleeping'. If a more specific sleeping bear is needed, source from TPT or Creative Fabrica.

ambiguous.issue: Could mean a dangerous fire/flames or a cosy campfire/hearth
ambiguous.reason: In the book the animals light a warm fire inside the cave for the party — a cosy hearth or campfire image is correct, not a dangerous blaze

ambiguous.issue: Could mean temperature (cold weather) or illness (a cold)
ambiguous.reason: The story is set in winter with snow outside — cold refers to the weather, not an illness

notes: Most key vocabulary (bear, cave, snow, mouse, fire, popcorn, sleep, wake, party, tea) already exists in activity_images or aac_extras — only 'friends', 'cold', and 'snore' are likely to need new sourcing. 'snore' may not exist in standard Boardmaker libraries; consider a sleeping face with ZZZ graphic or source from TPT. 'hare', 'badger', and 'crow' exist in activity_images but were deprioritised in favour of the collective concept 'friends' to keep the board functional and generalisable. 'tea' from aac_extras was replaced by the more plot-central 'party' and 'popcorn' which are already in activity_images. The fixed core row 5 already includes 'colour' and 'read' which support story interaction without needing fringe slots.
